geometry.weight_formula: For z>.010, s=smoothstep(.010,.018,z); nonWrist=float32(old*(1-s)); wrist=float32(1-sum(rounded nonWrist)); zero nonWrist influences removed. z<=.010 untouched.

final.weight_formula: For z>.010, s=smoothstep(.010,.018,z); nonWrist=float32(old*(1-s)); wrist=float32(1-sum(rounded nonWrist)); zero nonWrist influences removed. z<=.010 untouched.

preservation_scope: Only approved skin weights and named start metadata change. Mesh geometry, normals, UV, morph deltas, rest, material/images, lights/world/cameras unchanged; neutral evaluated appearance measured.
